batch.readabilityReason: Every required label and explanatory state/condition is readable in the visible target artwork. Titles, panel labels, arrows and supporting notes form a clear hierarchy; no observed clipping or text/shape collision.
batch.consistencyReason: Coherent rule spacing, dark ink titles, restrained irregular rectangular outlines, secondary gray edges, open arrowheads and role colors recur. Layouts vary meaningfully with ratio and task: horizontal state chain, four-seat grid, stacked handoff, wide parallel branches and portrait return routing.
batch.characterReason: The notebook margin/rules, skewed paper outlines, open pencil-like arrows and offset edges remain recognizable. However, the defining dense crosshatched panel regions are replaced with nearly white panels and occasional tiny corner slash marks. Lines and connectors are substantially cleaner and more regular, and the original expressive bold central lettering/underline construction is largely absent. Japanese/font and palette overrides are not penalized in themselves.
batch.factualSummary: No observed required-label omissions, invented facts or reversed transitions across the five images. Waiting, empty and completed states use text and/or outlines in addition to color.
losses: Dense, visibly hand-worked crosshatching no longer constructs large panel areas.
Original bolder central type/underline relationship is reduced to ordinary centered panel labels.
Connector and contour irregularity is restrained enough to read closer to a clean notebook diagram than a textured pencil sketch.
retained: Slightly nonparallel panel outlines with offset secondary edges.
Curved connectors/open arrowheads and generous whitespace.

fontAndScaleUncertainty.font: PNG appearance alone cannot establish the actual font family, fallback chain or runtime font resolution. Japanese glyphs appear intact and coherent; no visible missing-glyph boxes. Noto Sans CJK JP is requested, not independently verified from these PNGs.
fontAndScaleUncertainty.scale: Capture frames are larger than the stated target artwork by 48 horizontal and 96 vertical pixels. Review used the original PNGs displayed at their recorded pixel dimensions, judging the internal target artwork rather than the duplicate caption below it. Browser CSS/device scale and actual placement metadata were not inspected because outside allowed scope. No assertion of runtime/CSS/font provenance is made.
